full_prompt_en: A square dark close portrait painting centers a young adult woman facing the viewer. She wears a black leather aviator helmet or cap, with large worn metal-rimmed goggles strapped across the top of her head. The glass lenses are very dark and catch only narrow gray reflections. Loose black hair and a high dark collar frame her face. Her blue-gray eyes look directly outward beneath pronounced brows and dark smoky makeup. The lips are full, painted a vivid crimson red, and slightly parted. Warm blush crosses the cheeks, while a few tiny red marks or flecks sit on the left cheek. Large deep red roses surround her head on both sides and reappear near the lower right; some flower heads fade into the black background, their spiral petals revealed by selective highlights. A small metal or leather shoulder fitting emerges near the lower left, hinting at a rugged garment without showing the whole body. Light from front left and above brings out the face, forehead, nose, and the metallic rims of the goggles, while the neck and outer roses remain shadowed. The composition is tightly cropped from the top of the goggles to the upper chest. Materials are carefully differentiated: smooth skin, worn leather, reflective metal, soft dark hair, and velvety petals. The palette is restricted but rich—black, gunmetal, warm flesh, cobalt-gray eyes, and blood red. No setting or readable text appears. The mood is poised and defiant, combining pin-up polish with rough equipment and floral darkness. The gaze and red lips create an immediate focal point; the circular goggles and rose heads repeat rounded forms around it.
full_prompt_zh: 一幅方形深暗近景肖像绘画把一位年轻成年女子正面置于中央。她戴黑皮飞行头盔或帽，头顶绑着巨大磨旧金属边飞行护目镜。镜片很深，只接住窄灰反光。松散黑发与高深色衣领框住脸。蓝灰眼在分明眉弓和深色烟熏妆下直接向外看。嘴唇丰满，涂鲜明绯红，微微张开。暖红晕越过脸颊，左脸还有少数细小红点或色斑。深红玫瑰从两侧围住头部，右下也再出现；部分花朵隐进黑背景，只靠选择性高光揭示盘旋花瓣。左下露出一小块金属或皮革肩件，暗示结实服装，却不展示全身。前左与上方光照亮脸、前额、鼻和护目镜金属边，颈与外围玫瑰仍深暗。构图从护目镜顶到上胸紧密裁切。材质仔细区分：平滑皮肤、磨旧皮革、反光金属、柔深发和天鹅绒般花瓣。色盘受限却丰厚——黑、枪灰、暖肤色、钴灰眼和血红。没有场景或可读文字。氛围镇定而倔强，把海报美感与粗装备、花卉暗色结合。凝视和红唇立即成为焦点；圆镜片与玫瑰花头在其周围重复圆形。
style_prompt_en: The dark painterly treatment combines polished smooth highlights with weathered leatherlike and metallic details against velvety floral shadow. Black and gunmetal dominate, interrupted by warm skinlike planes, blue-gray focal glints, and saturated crimson clusters. Tight centered cropping concentrates attention on direct expressive features, while repeated circular lenses and petal spirals make a decorative frame. A restrained frontal-side light reveals surface differences—soft matte, worn seams, hard reflective rims, and layered petals—without brightening the whole field. Reds are rich and localized, not spread evenly. The finish feels both glossy and distressed, with fine paint grain and controlled deep blacks. The mood is dramatic, poised, and slightly Gothic.
style_prompt_zh: 深暗绘画处理把抛光般平滑高光、磨旧皮革般和金属细节与天鹅绒花影结合。黑与枪灰主导，被暖肤色般平面、蓝灰焦点闪点和饱和绯红群打断。紧密居中裁切集中注意力于直接而有表情的特征，重复圆镜与螺旋花瓣形成装饰框。克制前侧光揭示柔哑光、磨损拼缝、坚硬反光环和层叠花瓣等表面差异，却不把整幅照亮。红色浓而局部，不平均撒开。完成度同时发亮与斑驳，有细颜料颗粒与受控深黑。气氛戏剧性、镇定且略带哥特。
theme_en: A leather-helmeted woman with aviator goggles and red lipstick framed by dark red roses
theme_zh: 皮头盔、飞行镜与红唇女子被深红玫瑰围住
name: Brian M. Viveros
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
